_about: Seasonal world events (List 20 #195). A season is calendar data; an event is a bundle of registrations in their owners' formats. Events change availability windows only. The calendar itself is OPEN (#93/#105), so the fragment instances no season and no event.

registrations.fixtures: #124 rotation fixture ids — what rotates in
registrations.overlays: #113-discipline overlay records — encounter availability; roll-time transforms, base #7 tables never change

event.resolution: derived at read time over the world clock (#124) — the active set is never stored; media (#90/#172) announces only what the derivation activates
event.window: predicate over #105's calendar layer (abstract season + #19 phase vocabulary)
event.writes: NO canon facts — no story/progress flags, no dex states, no table edits; availability during a window is overlay presentation only

fences: never the Dark Forest depths — #113's Forest exception, absolute; no seasonal overlay targets them, no event animates them

no-pressure law (#105 on #56's ethic): everything recurs, nothing is earnable only once, goods are cosmetic/record/care-class — never power, never story progress, never a species' only availability window

season.regionScope: regionId | all — regional seasons differ by #142 climate authorship, when authored
season.status: SHAPE ONLY — the calendar (season names, day kinds, year shape) is the owner's OPEN ruling, inherited from #93/#105; zero seasons instanced
season.window: predicate over the calendar layer, once a calendar exists
